title: Tidying for Mr. Amos

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Thank you for coming. With my sore hand, I can't pick up the little things. My nails and screws are all mixed up!

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Could you sort them into their pots for me?

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put the nails, the screws and the hooks each in their own pot.
steps.hint: Nails are smooth. Screws have a twist. Hooks are bent.

feedback.mismatch: Look closely: is it a nail, a screw, or a hook?
feedback.all_good: All sorted! You've been my good right hand today.

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: When one of us is hurting, the others carry them a little. That's what neighbors are for.

journal_line: I sorted Mr. Amos's nails and screws while his hand was sore.
unavailable_text: The workshop is tidy for today.
